notes: Four distinct movable-part episodes are visible: two separate lower drawers and the two independently hinged doors of the upper cabinet. The two upper cabinet closures occur rapidly between frames 552 and 560, so their individual ordering and midpoints are less certain.
scene_description: A person moves around a narrow modern kitchen and manipulates a food-storage drawer, both doors of an upper cabinet above the cooktop, and a separate utensil drawer.
